title: Investigate left arm sag on exit and test episode quality
goal: Diagnose exit hazard without hardware operation; audit recorded test episodes and fix bounded control lifecycle defects.
doneWhen: Exit hazard traced with evidence and mitigation verified or blocker documented
decisions: Checkpoint f1ab23e committed prior UI fixes and operator reset poses
Scope is control adaptation and necessary fixes only; capture/upload unchanged
Operator reproduced left-only exit sag; dual stop order is not a necessary trigger
Do not connect, recover, reproduce sag, change gains/limits or silently retain active controller
Current bounded increment: per-IP shutdown phase logs, successful stop exits command server, lifecycle stop wait budget and surfaced stop errors; retain physical stopping algorithm

2026-10-26 offline episode audit quantified a left-only residual load: static Cartesian impedance steady-state error (measured tcp_pose minus recorded command_tcp_target at |dq|<0.01 rad/s) is -8.9 mm vertical on the left (129 episodes, 100% negative, IQR -10.3..-8.1 mm) versus +1.0 mm on the right (31 episodes); with K_t=1200 N/m that is ~11 N (~1.0-1.15 kg equivalent) unmodelled downward force on the left versus ~3 N noise floor on the right; same-session dual pairs 20261023 give -8.18 vs +1.04 mm

Working diagnosis: the impedance controller supports the left arm with ~10 N of position-error force; TorqueStopMotion ramps tau_command to damping+Coriolis only, removing that support while libfranka internal gravity compensation keeps using the same mismatched load model, so the left arm starts moving inside the stop window (recorded pre-exit dq approx 0) and only re-satisfies |dq|<0.02 rad/s after 1.10-1.58 s (right 0.203 s, i.e. at ramp end), then holds once the torque loop ends

Residual is 96% vertical downward, which rules out base tilt (horizontal bias) and target/mapping offset (zero at grip press), so it is load-model or external-force class rather than a controller or frame bug
Do not mask it by raising stiffness/damping/limits or by keeping the impedance controller alive on exit; the defect to fix is the robot-side load model for the left arm

ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED 2026-10-26 by read-only robot query: left arm 172.16.0.2 reports m_ee=0.0000, m_load=0.0000, m_total=0.0000 kg, F_x_Cee/F_x_Cload/F_x_Ctotal=[0,0,0], F_T_EE and EE_T_K translation [0,0,0] while robot_mode=Idle; the robot's gravity model therefore treats the flange as bare although a Robotiq 2F-85 + wrist camera + bracket + cable are mounted

Physical load measured two independent ways, agreeing: joint-torque fit against franky's own model gives 1.031-1.041 kg with CoM [0.037,0.010,0.09] m (three recording subsets, 4718-14414 rest samples), and the impedance force balance gives 10.7-11.2 N; right arm fitted the same way gives 0.954 kg/CoM [0.037,0.035,0.082] m, so both arms carry ~1 kg of hardware and only the left model omits it

Right arm 172.16.0.3 read once Desk FCI was enabled: m_ee=1.0000, m_load=0, F_x_Cee=[0.05,0.0,0.057], I_ee=diag(0.00277,0.00315,0.00564), F_T_EE=[0,0,0.16]; that is the deliberate working configuration to copy, and it also bounds the residual to ~0 N on the right

FIX APPLIED 2026-10-26 by the operator in Desk (Settings -> End effector, Generic Device) on the left robot only: mass 1.0 kg, flange->CoM [0.05,0.0,0.057] m, inertia diag 0.00277/0.00315/0.00564 kg*m^2; read-back confirms m_ee=1.0000, m_load=0, m_total=1.0000, F_x_Cee=[0.05,0.0,0.057]

Deliberately left 'Flange to TCP' at 0 on the left (right arm uses 0.16 m): changing it would shift the TCP reference by 16 cm and invalidate the stored reset_ee_pose, which was taught in the flange frame; gravity compensation depends only on mass/CoM/inertia

Operator confirms the left-arm exit sag no longer occurs after the Desk change; no post-fix recording has been analysed yet, so the objective acceptance metrics (static error approaching 0, tracker stop approaching 0.2 s) are still outstanding

Open follow-ups, not part of this task: left end-effector collision spheres (Watchman Safety Setup) were never configured because the left model had no end effector at all, and the left/right TCP frame origins still differ by 0.16 m in recorded data

TCP frame alignment done 2026-10-26 as a separate change: Desk left Flange to TCP set to z=0.16 (matching the right, pure translation, rotation identity, confirmed by reading F_T_EE=F_T_NE=[0,0,0.16] on 172.16.0.2), and left reset_ee_pose converted in config/franka-rig.json to [0.5575695238,-0.1992708666,0.260377417] with the quaternion, orientation_target_euler and ee_pose_limit_* unchanged; the converted value maps back to the original flange pose [0.5632,-0.195,0.4202], so the physical reset pose is preserved and no re-teaching was needed; representative recordings before this change remain in the flange frame

verification.summary: RESOLVED 2026-10-26. Root cause: the left robot's configured load model was empty (m_ee=m_load=m_total=0) while ~1.04 kg of Robotiq gripper, wrist camera, bracket and cable was mounted, so libfranka gravity compensation was missing that mass; the Cartesian impedance controller silently supplied the missing ~11 N through a -8.9 mm standing error, and TorqueStopMotion removed exactly that support on exit, so the left arm fell inside the stop window (1.10-1.58 s to re-reach |dq|<0.02 rad/s versus 0.203 s on the right) and held once the torque loop ended. The operator configured the left end effector in Desk with the right arm's values (1.0 kg, CoM [0.05,0,0.057], inertia diag 0.00277/0.00315/0.00564); read-back confirms the values landed and the operator reports the exit sag no longer occurs. Earlier lifecycle/log fixes remain uncommitted after f1ab23e.
checks: Dual episode125531:518 complete frames/side, all finite and HDF5 matches NPZ; telemetry repeats left2.9%,right9.1%
Left episode131032:629 frames,left+global,left-only HDF5 matches NPZ; near-zero final recorded velocity before exit; no exit telemetry

134 episodes carry robot/<side>/command_tcp_target; per-episode median static vertical error left=-9.36 mm (all 134 negative) right=+0.95 mm (28% negative); step 2 confirms |dq|<0.01 rad/s subsets: left -8.91 mm vector [-2.3,+0.7,-8.9] (96% vertical), right 2.49 mm magnitude with no consistent direction

Result is stable across sessions and modes: left -8.18 mm on 20261023 dual, -9.45 mm on 20261025 left-only; time-series within an episode shows the error settling to this value rather than decaying to zero

2026-10-26 read-only tools/franka_load_dump.py against 172.16.0.2 with no worker running: robot_mode=Idle, m_ee=m_load=m_total=0.0000 kg, all CoM and F_T_EE/EE_T_K translations zero; 172.16.0.3 refused because Desk FCI is disabled there, so the right arm's configured values are still unread

2026-10-26 tools/franka_load_fit.py fitting recorded rest-sample joint torques against franky's model: left 1.0406/1.0309/1.0369 kg over three subsets (CoM z 0.093/0.053/0.087 m), right 0.9544 kg (CoM [0.037,0.035,0.082] m); torque rms residual 0.39-0.58 Nm against 0.76-1.11 Nm signal

Post-fix read-back of 172.16.0.2 (no worker, robot_mode=Idle): m_ee=1.0000, m_load=0.0000, m_total=1.0000, F_x_Cee=[0.05,0.0,0.057], F_x_Ctotal=[0.05,0.0,0.057], F_T_EE still [0,0,0] - identical load model to the right arm
limitations: Fix is operator-reported: no post-fix recording has been analysed, so the objective acceptance metrics (left static error approaching the right arm's ~+1 mm, tracker stop approaching ~0.2 s) are still unmeasured

Configured mass 1.0 kg vs fitted 1.03-1.04 kg and force-balance 1.09-1.14 N/kg-equivalent: a residual of ~0.4-1.4 N (~0.3-1.2 mm at K_t=1200) may remain; expected to be at the right arm's level but unverified

Torque fit residual is 0.39-0.58 Nm rms against 0.76-1.11 Nm signal (44-76%), because the recorded rest samples cover a narrow posture range and include joint friction; it bounds the mass estimate rather than proving it to 10 g
Left end-effector collision spheres (Watchman Safety Setup) are still unconfigured, so gripper collision detection relies on the default shape; not evaluated
Left/right TCP frame origins still differ by 0.16 m (left F_T_EE=0, right 0.16); unifying them requires re-teaching the left reset_ee_pose and was deliberately out of scope
Static-error method needs held-grip samples; 134 left vs 31 right episodes qualified because older recordings lack command_tcp_target, and the right arm has no left-arm-length baseline
No synchronized exit pose telemetry: sag distance, start/end instants and brake engagement remain inferred from stop duration and operator reports, not measured
Control env lacks application dependencies; full suite uses .venv
